exposure: Excessive maternal weight gain during pregnancy
cohort: 7122 women who gave birth between 2013-2015 at the Second Department of Gynecology and Obstetrics at the University Hospital in Bratislava, Slovakia
finding: Overweight and obesity during pregnancy were significantly associated with increased risk of gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, gestational diabetes mellitus, and cesarean section.
mod_finding: Gestational weight gain above IOM recommendations was associated with a higher risk of cesarean section.
